newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers drop, rest of Europe steady.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers drop, rest of Europe steady.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices dropped on Tuesday as the barge market shed $4, while prices in the rest of Europe and the Middle East were steady, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were quoted at around $83/$84 fob, as the barge market fell as low as $81.
However, as on Monday, bunker demand was very low, barely reaching 5,000 tonnes in total. Suppliers said few shipowners were even enquiring.
"Yesterday, we saw 5,000 tonnes. If it's as much again today, I'd be surprised," one supplier said.
Hamburg bunkers were unchanged from Monday, leaving a wider Hamburg-Rotterdam differential and barely any business. Supplies remained good.
Mediterranean prices were all unchanged and trading slack.
Egyptian fuel oil bunkers rose $2/$3 a tonne. As before, Port Said was dry and Alexandria deliveries subject to enquiries.
Fujairah was a rare market with activity. Buyers, anticipating price rises, moved in. Earlier, fuel oil fell $2.
